questions.question: What is a bobtail tractor?

options.text: A tractor that travels faster than the speed limit

questions.explanation: A bobtail tractor is a tractor without a semi-trailer. These tractors are hard to operate and require careful driving.

questions.question: If you see a distracted driver, you should:

options.text: Keep a safe distance from the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep a safe distance from the vehicle.
questions.explanation: When you see a distracted driver, stay far away and keep a safe following distance.

questions.question: Which of the following is acceptable during a pre-trip tire inspection?

options.text: Tires that do not match in size
Front tire tread of 3/32 of an inch

questions.explanation: Front tires must have at least 4/32 inch of tread depth. Other tires must have at least 2/32 inch of tread depth. All tires on the same vehicle must be the same size. Tires from different manufacturers are acceptable.

questions.question: A hazard class shows:

options.text: How fast the material must be delivered.

questions.explanation: Hazardous materials are put into one of nine classes. Each class explains the type of dangers the material poses.

questions.question: Before entering a curve, you should:
questions.explanation: Before entering a curve, slow down to a safe speed and shift into a lower gear.

questions.question: All trailers made after ____ must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS).
questions.explanation: All trailers and converter dollies made on or after March 1, 1998 must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS).

questions.question: If you are unfamiliar with an area where you must back up, you should:

options.text: Get out and walk around to check the area.
Not use both side mirrors because it is distracting.
Wait for someone else to back up first so you can watch.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out and walk around to check the area.
questions.explanation: Before backing up, get out of your vehicle and check your path. Look at the sides and overhead to make sure you have enough clearance.

questions.question: After an accident, use flares with caution because:

options.text: Other drivers may not see flares in sunny weather.

questions.explanation: Improper flare use near spilled fuel is a common cause of fires after accidents. Use flares carefully.

questions.question: In heavy traffic, the safest speed is:
questions.explanation: In heavy traffic, drive at the same speed as other vehicles. When two vehicles travel at the same speed in the same direction, they cannot hit each other.

questions.question: A driver with an open window in cold weather may be:

options.text: A person who enjoys fresh air.

questions.explanation: Watch for signs that a driver may be impaired by alcohol, drugs, drowsiness, or illness. One sign is having windows down in cold weather. This is a clue that a driver might be impaired.

questions.question: A tired driver:

options.text: Is usually more careful than a normal driver.
May take longer to make important decisions.

questions.correctAnswerText: May take longer to make important decisions.
questions.explanation: Tired drivers are slower to notice or react to dangers. Drowsy drivers cannot make decisions as quickly as alert drivers.

questions.question: A pre-trip inspection should check:
questions.explanation: Before driving, check the engine oil level, coolant level, and hose condition in the engine compartment.

questions.question: If a trailer starts to jackknife, the driver should:

options.text: Not use the trailer hand brake.
Use the parking brake to straighten the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not use the trailer hand brake.
questions.explanation: If a trailer jackknifes, release the brakes so the wheels regain grip on the road. Do not use the trailer hand brake. Braking caused the wheels to lock in the first place.

questions.question: Hazardous material containers must be:

options.text: Secured to prevent movement during transport.

questions.correctAnswerText: Secured to prevent movement during transport.
questions.explanation: Containers of hazardous materials must be secured so they will not fall, slide, or move around during transport.

questions.question: Rolling backward when accelerating is dangerous because:

options.text: The truck is not designed to go backwards.
You may hit a vehicle behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may hit a vehicle behind you.
questions.explanation: Make sure you can accelerate without rolling backward first. Rolling backward can cause you to crash into a vehicle or obstacle behind your truck.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver confronts you, you should:

options.text: Make eye contact to communicate better.
Not move out of their way.

questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver confronts you, get out of their way if possible. Do not make eye contact, as it may anger them. Do not let them provoke you.

questions.question: Liquid surge happens in:

options.text: Tanks that have not been used recently.

questions.explanation: Liquid surge occurs when liquid moves inside partially filled tanks.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a cause of hydraulic brake failure?
questions.explanation: Hydraulic brake failure usually comes from two causes: loss of hydraulic pressure or overheated brakes on long hills that fade.

questions.question: When driving in wet conditions, if other vehicles' tires are not spraying water, it means:

options.text: Ice has formed on the road.
The spray is trapped under the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ice has formed on the road.
questions.explanation: In wet conditions, no spray from tires means ice is on the road. Be extra careful in wet conditions when it is cold enough to freeze.

questions.question: In a vehicle with an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), brakes should be applied:

options.text: The same way as in a vehicle without ABS.
While the vehicle is in neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same way as in a vehicle without ABS.
questions.explanation: In a vehicle with ABS, brake the same way you would in a vehicle without ABS.
